name: i/2-subdivision with quadrilinear B-spline wavelets
definition: A multiresolution hierarchy for four-dimensional data sets (3D space + 1 time) that combines i/2 subdivision with quadrilinear B-spline wavelets to provide better approximation quality and spatial locality for progressive visualization.
summary: This method constructs a multiresolution hierarchy for 4D data by combining i/2 subdivision with quadrilinear B-spline wavelets to preserve fine details during downsampling, offering finer granularity than octree-based approaches.
